name: floksy-jewel
description: Floksy Jewel Luxury E-Commerce & Diamond Vault Platform

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/verify-build.js
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate && npm run build && node ../scripts/verify-build.js
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
